_comment: Authored summary targets — plan.md §9. Keyed by dataset record id. Merge with: npm --prefix api run merge:dataset
_batch: 010 — GREEN weighting to close the band gap, and the last batch to the ~150 target. Several patients here have almost no clinical signal at all; the summary has to make the absence of findings legible rather than padding it out.
green_acute_mechanical-006:
**Snapshot** — 40y man, Lucknow. Lower back pain for 2 to 6 weeks after lifting.

**Key findings**
- Sudden onset after lifting or bending
- Pain stays in the back — no radiation past the thigh
- No numbness, weakness or red flags
- Walking unrestricted; sleep undisturbed
- Rest only; no medication or other treatment tried

**Supporting the triage verdict** — Under six weeks, mechanical onset, no neurological findings and no red flags. This sits inside the natural-history window.

**What the doctor may want to ask**
- He wrote *(translated)*: "I have been suffering a long time. I have to work and I cannot bear the pain either." His note reads longer-standing than the six weeks recorded — worth clarifying when it really began.
- Whether rest means complete rest, which tends to slow recovery
green_untreated_chronic-005:
